import numpy as np
# Baseline subtraction: line through mean(1100±10) and mean(1800±10)
m1 = np.mean(y1[(x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)])
m2 = np.mean(y1[(x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)])
base = m1 + (m2 - m1) * (x - 1100) / (1800 - 1100)
y1 = y1 - base
# Normalize G band max to 1
g_mask = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
if np.any(g_mask):
    g_max = np.max(y1[g_mask])
    if g_max != 0:
        y1 = y1 / g_max
